defective_pattern: Hardcoding raw SEM fit indices in task delegation envelopes and verifying deliverables circularly against these CDE expectations instead of the physical canonical output file (fit_measures_sem.csv).
why_defective: This creates a circular validation blindspot where the orchestrator's stale or hallucinated metrics are passed off as verified, overriding the actual calculated parameters.
observed_symptoms: Validation script asserts against CDE expectations rather than loading CSV
Deliverable matches CDE but contradicts CSV
corrective_remedy: Mandate that macro SEM model fit reporting must strictly bind to the canonical revised model in fit_measures_sem.csv with verified correlated error paths, and forbid circular validator assertions based on unverified CDE criteria.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Validator circularly checking CDE instead of disk CSV
